description: Requests for the dashboard agent, with the checks any good result must pass. See src/sqlagent/dashboard_eval.py.

cases.request: Marketing overview: revenue trend, top categories, repeat customers and payment mix
Delivery performance: late-delivery rate by customer state and how delays affect review scores
Category deep dive for 2018: revenue, orders and average order value by product category
Seller performance: top sellers by revenue, where sellers are based, and the average review per seller
Customer retention: how many customers come back, and how repeat orders change over time
A one-page executive summary of the marketplace for the board
Show only Sao Paulo customers, from January 2018

start.title: Totals
start.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM sales

start.title: Revenue by month
start.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_date >= '2017-01-01' AND order_date < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

start.title: Orders by payment type
start.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM sales WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY orders DESC

start.title: Top categories by revenue
start.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
